info.description: Gets the tagging snippet for a Container.
info.title: Tag Manager API

requests.description: Lists all GTM Accounts that a user has access to.
requests.name: GET /tagmanager/v2/accounts
requests.note: Replace {{TAG_MANAGER_API_KEY}} with your API key

requests.description: Looks up a Container by destination ID.
requests.name: GET /tagmanager/v2/accounts/containers:lookup
requests.note: Replace {{TAG_MANAGER_API_KEY}} with your API key

requests.description: Lists all the enabled Built-In Variables of a GTM Container.
requests.name: GET /tagmanager/v2/{parent}/built_in_variables
requests.note: Replace {{TAG_MANAGER_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Creates one or more GTM Built-In Variables.
requests.name: POST /tagmanager/v2/{parent}/built_in_variables
requests.note: Replace {{TAG_MANAGER_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values
